title: Robotics Software Engineer
summary: A robotics software engineer writes the code that lets a robot sense its surroundings, know where it is and move safely, mostly using ROS (Robot Operating System, a common software framework for robots). They work in a robotics team alongside mechanical, electronics and test engineers and spend time both in simulation and on real robots.
dailyDuties: Write and debug ROS 2 nodes in C++ or Python
Tune navigation and motion planning for new sites
Test changes in simulation before field trials
Integrate and calibrate lidar, camera and IMU sensors
Analyse recorded robot logs to find faults
Support field tests and fix issues found on site

skills.expectation: Build ROS 2 nodes, launch files and packages
Write real-time robot code in modern C++
Write tools, tests and nodes in Python
Develop and debug on Ubuntu Linux
Tune Nav2 or MoveIt planners and controllers
Run and tune SLAM and localization on the robot
Combine lidar, IMU and wheel data into a reliable pose
Test robot software in Gazebo or Isaac Sim before field trials
Work in a shared repository with reviews
Process camera images for perception tasks
Write gtest or pytest tests for robot code
Run builds and tests in a pipeline
Deploy models on NVIDIA Jetson boards
